label: The meditator thinks, therefore some thought episode occurs
description: Strength order registration: if the meditator bears some occurring thought episode, then some thought episode occurs (STMT ThoughtOccurs, e81971f1), with the same occurrence predicate. The first-person cogito also yields a thinking subject directly, without the bearer principle (30e6e01c), for this case. It establishes neither statement; strictness is not registered. The existing control with an occurring thought and no bearer (6cffb105) suggests strictness but does not certify it for this pair (different vocabulary: it has no designated meditator); a strength_comparison of the pair is a follow-up.
